entries.status: No EU-level schedule or class. EU legislation does not establish classes of narcotic or psychotropic substances; Member States classify drugs according to the 1961, 1971 and 1988 UN Conventions. The Framework Decision on illicit drug trafficking defines 'drug' as any substance covered by the 1961 Single Convention (as amended by the 1972 Protocol) or by the 1971 Convention, or listed in its Annex.

entries.instrument: Перечень наркотических средств, психотропных веществ и их прекурсоров, подлежащих контролю в Российской Федерации (утв. постановлением Правительства РФ от 30.06.1998 № 681, ред. от 11.06.2025), Список I, «Наркотические средства»: «Псилоцибин»

entries.source_date: ред. от 11.06.2025 (version stated by Roszdravnadzor on its page for the act); PDF pages stamped 27.03.2026; posted 30.03.2026
entries.checked_by: AI reader W2 (two WebFetch readings compared by script)
entries.note: Entries in the Perechen are unnumbered; no item number is printed. List I = substances whose circulation in Russia is prohibited («оборот которых в Российской Федерации запрещен»). Psilocybin mushrooms as such belong to the separate plants list (Resolution 934), which could not be read from an official source. The general provisions after List I extend control to its isomers and stereoisomers («если таковые определенно не исключены»), esters and ethers, salts, and all mixtures regardless of quantity.

entries.status: Psilocybin: Covered by reference, not named: Proclamation No. 1112/2019, Art. 2(12), 'psychotropic substance' (substances controlled under the UN psychotropic substances convention ratified by Ethiopia)
entries.instrument: Food and Medicine Administration Proclamation No. 1112/2019, Art. 2(12): 'psychotropic substance' means 'any substance subject to control in accordance with the Convention issued by United Nations' and ratified by Ethiopia, and includes a drug the executive organ categorizes as psychotropic. Amharic text: 'ሳይኮትሮፒክ መድኃኒት' (psychotropic medicine), controlled under 'የሳይኮትሮፒክ ንጥረ-ነገሮች ስምምነት' (the psychotropic substances convention)
entries.source_title: Food and Medicine Administration Proclamation No. 1112/2019 (አዋጅ ቁጥር ፩ሺ፩፻፲፪/፪ሺ፲፩, ስለምግብ እና መድኃኒት አስተዳደር የወጣ አዋጅ)
entries.source_date: Federal Negarit Gazette, 25th Year No. 39, 28th February, 2019 (የካቲት ፳፩ ቀን ፪ሺ፲፩ ዓ.ም), p. 11099; cited as the legal basis of EFDA Directive No. 1121/2025 (December 2025)
entries.checked_by: AI reader W2 (two WebFetch readings compared by script)
entries.note: The site's UN layer places Psilocybin in Schedule I of the Convention on Psychotropic Substances, 1971. Ethiopia is a party to the 1971 Convention (accession 1980-06-23), per the site's UN Treaty Collection data. Not named in any Ethiopian list read (National List of May 2017, Parts I-IV and Annex forms; EFDA tramadol notice; Directive No. 1121/2025, readable part). The Proclamation fixes no date and no schedule numbers for the reference; whether it reaches substances scheduled internationally after 28 February 2019 is unsettled (see 'unsettled').
